diagnosis: Customer on unified_auth startup plan with basic support tier claims token leaked in public repo. Requesting fastest safe rotation. Knowledge base article kb-0003 covers scoped key rotation: create replacement, move traffic, then revoke old key immediately. No escalation needed per policy.
reply: Thank you for contacting us. Since your account uses Unified Auth, you can rotate your credentials by creating a new scoped API key, moving your traffic to it, and then immediately revoking the old key. This process is covered in our guide on scoped API keys (kb-0003). There is no built-in grace period once you revoke the previous key, so please ensure your new key is working before revoking the old one. If you need further assistance, let us know.
